newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Tsang says free information is "lifeblood".
newsitem.headline: HK's Tsang says free information is "lifeblood".

text.p: Hong Kong Financial Secretary Donald Tsang, presenting his budget for the year when China takes back the territory, said on Wednesday that the free flow of information is the "lifeblood" of a modern economy.
"The free flow of information is the lifeblood of a modern service economy," Tsang said.

"It leads to transparency and accountability in both the private and public sectors. It is the best protection against corruption and abuse of power not only by government but in the business world as well."
Tsang called the rule of law, a level playing field, a corruption-free government and the free flow of information the "four pillars of wisdom" guiding Hong Kong into the 21st century.
